reasoning: This gazette content contains rules made by the Sri Lanka Anti-Doping Agency under the Convention Against Doping in Sport Act, No. 33 of 2013. It establishes regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and legal procedures for anti-doping enforcement in sports. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
